posts.title: The overnight bus to Manali
posts.excerpt: Fourteen hours on a Volvo out of Delhi, and the first morning in the mountains.

blocks.body:
We left Kashmere Gate a little after six in the evening. By midnight the highway had narrowed, and by four the air coming through the window gap was cold enough to wake everyone up.

posts.title: The trail to Jogini Falls
posts.excerpt: An easy uphill walk from Vashisht that took twice as long as planned.

blocks.body:
The trail starts behind the temple in Vashisht and climbs through orchards before opening up near the falls. It's about an hour each way if you don't stop. We stopped a lot.

posts.title: A morning at Amer Fort
posts.excerpt: Getting there at opening time was the best decision of the trip.

blocks.body:
We were through the gate by eight, and for the first hour the courtyards were nearly empty.

### Worth knowing

1. Go at opening time.
2. The composite ticket covers several monuments.
3. Carry water; the climb is longer than it looks.

blocks.caption: The walls from the upper terrace.

posts.title: Building a study tracker for my group
posts.excerpt: Timers, a shared to-do list and a leaderboard, built with plain JavaScript and Firebase.

blocks.body:
Sections aren't only for trips. This one shows how a project write-up looks.

## The stack

- HTML, CSS and JavaScript
- Firebase for sign-in and the database
- Hosted on Vercel

## What I'd do differently

Plan the data structure first. Changing it after people had started using the app was the hardest part.
